newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Auspine sees A$5.0 mln H1 net loss.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Auspine sees A$5.0 mln H1 net loss.

text.p: Timber products group Auspine Ltd said it expected to report a net loss before abnormal items of about A$5.0 million in the first half ending December 31 compared with an earlier forecast for a smaller loss.
The company said the revised forecast was based on a board meeting on Tuesday which reviewed the profit outlook for the 1996/97 year.
It said the company hoped to return to profitability in the second half of 1996/97 due to management changes that would take place over the next few months.

Auspine said the worse-than-expected first half result would be due to the continuation of difficult trading conditions in the domestic housing market and the international woodchip markets, as well as the impact of a well-publicised board disagreement which had distracted management.
The company said on August 22 that its 1995/96 net profit slumped to A$4.45 million from A$17.25 million a year earlier.
Rodney Hartley resigned as chairman of the board in late September, citing a breakdown in boardroom operations.
